definitions.explanation: A wheel-shaped exercise toy placed in a cage for small pets such as hamsters and squirrels, which run inside it, causing it to spin.

examples.japanese: ハムスターが{回|まわ}し{車|ぐるま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}っている→走る：00519_hashiru⟧。
examples.english: The hamster is running on its exercise wheel.

examples.japanese: ケージ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{回|まわ}し{車|ぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I attached an exercise wheel to the cage.
I woke up in the middle of the night to the sound of the exercise wheel spinning.

notes:
⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to spin) + {車|ぐるま} (wheel): a spinning wheel toy for small caged pets, letting them run in place for exercise. A standard fixture in hamster and squirrel cages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {回|まわ}し{車|ぐるま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧: to run on the exercise wheel
- {回|まわ}し{車|ぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{付|つ}ける: to attach an exercise wheel (to a cage)
